newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady or weaker in thin business.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady or weaker in thin business.

text.p: NWE oil products were unchanged or weaker on Tuesday, traders said.

Gasoline was little changed. Spot prices dipped in early business but steadied when NYMEX unleaded futures improved later. Naphtha held steady at slightly lower levels as crude futures reversed early losses.

High sulphur fuel oil was steady and barges traded at $96.50 fob ARA. Low sulphur cargoes weakened by around a dollar a tonne. Gas oil dropped up to $3 a tonne, reflecting a drop in IPE futures. Premiums were broadly steady.
